senses.gloss: c. (v. preced.) step, stairs, ladder. Targ. II Esth. I, 2.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 9:13">Targ. II Kings IX, 13</cite> <he>דְּ׳ שַׁעֲיָא</he> (h. text <he>גרם המעלות</he>, v. <cite ref="C01353"><he>גֶּרֶם</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:9">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 10b:15">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> (phonet. etymol.) <he>ד̇ר̇ך ג̇ג</he> a way to the roof.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:10">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>נחית ד׳ … סק ד׳ וכ׳</he> go down a step when taking a wife, go up a step in choosing a groomsman; Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ.

<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:1">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>לשינתא</he>, <he>ד׳ לפחדא</he> inviting fear, sleep; v. <cite ref="A00782"><he>אַוְסֵי</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>דַּרְגִּין</he>. Targ. O. a. Y. II <cite ref="Exodus 20:23">Ex. XX, 23</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 6:13">Targ. II Sam. VI, 13</cite> <he>דרג׳</he> Regia a. Kimḥi (ed. <he>זוג׳</he>).
